title: Gospel
definition: The Gospel is the good news that God saves sinners through the life, death, resurrection, and lordship of Jesus Christ.
summary: The Gospel announces salvation by grace through faith in Jesus Christ.
christFocus: Jesus Christ is the center of the Gospel: He died for sins, rose from the dead, reigns as Lord, and calls sinners to repentance and faith.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
The Gospel is not good advice about how people can improve themselves. It is good news about what God has done in Christ to save sinners. Humanity is guilty before God, unable to rescue itself, and in need of grace.

Jesus lived the righteous life sinners failed to live, died for sins, rose from the dead, and reigns as Lord. The Gospel calls people to repent, believe, receive forgiveness, and follow Christ.

The Gospel is the center of Christian faith and mission. Every doctrine of salvation flows from the good news of Christ crucified and risen.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Many people either minimize sin or try to earn acceptance with God through effort. The Gospel matters because it announces that salvation is God's work in Christ, received by faith, not achieved by human performance.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Believe the Gospel personally and proclaim it clearly. Return to the Gospel when guilt, pride, fear, or self-reliance rise up. Let the good news of Christ shape your worship, witness, and daily obedience.
